condition: IL-11 or LIF challenge of primary human EEC; IL-11-neutralizing antibody; LIF antagonist; STAT3 inhibitor; integrin-alpha2beta1 neutralizing antibody; primary first-trimester trophoblast in the attachment assay
observation: FULL TEXT VERIFIED 2026-09-16 (PDF now held). Both cytokines increased adhesion of primary human EEC to fibronectin and collagen IV and both increased integrin-alpha2 mRNA and protein. STAT3 INHIBITION REDUCED BOTH IL-11- and LIF-mediated adhesion to fibronectin, and neutralizing either ligand abolished its own pSTAT3 -- so the shared convergence node is positively demonstrated, not inferred. But the two ligands DISSOCIATE twice: 'IL-11 stimulated, whereas LIF had no effect on the adhesion of trophoblast to endometrial epithelial cells', and 'LIF but not IL-11 induced adhesion to collagen IV was reduced by an integrin-alpha2beta1 neutralizing antibody'.
notes: ESTABLISHED: (a) a shared STAT3 convergence node, demonstrated by STAT3 inhibition reducing BOTH responses -- so E_GP130_STAT3 is a real state and not an artefact; (b) a second GP130-family ligand acts in human endometrial epithelium, so E_GP130_STAT3 = E_LIF is false. ALSO ESTABLISHED, and the sharper point: the ligands dissociate DOWNSTREAM of both STAT3 and ITGA2, on collagen-IV/alpha2beta1 and on trophoblast attachment -- the endpoint closest to ADOC's own readout. A convergent-only motif is therefore NECESSARY BUT NOT SUFFICIENT: it predicts interchangeability, which this refutes. EXPLICITLY NOT ESTABLISHED: IL-11-dependent active or required alpha2beta1 -- the primary reports the NEGATIVE, which is stronger than absence of evidence and sustains the 2026-09-11 rejection of that edge at confidence=verified. Trophoblast was primary first-trimester, so the dissociation is human-human.

notes: ESTABLISHED: IGFBP-1 has a real, IGF-INDEPENDENT outgoing causal route via alpha5beta1 onto the decidual state, so S_IGFBP1 is not a passive reporter. QUESTION NOW CLOSED, and it narrows the claim: decidualization was scored by MORPHOLOGY AND PRL RELEASE, so PRL is the READOUT of decidualization in this design and NO separate direct IGFBP-1 -> PRL edge is established.
